summary: Tested Nishant Jain PMS marketing site end-to-end. All 6 pytest backend tests passed (root, contact POST success + GET persistence, invalid email 422, missing required 422, empty-name/message 400, GET list with no _id). Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, hero displays 'Nishant Jain' with FY2026-27 stats (Net P&L ₹3,78,101.08, Net ROI 12.60%, XIRR 52.81%, Win Rate 72.22%). Navbar testids all present and lenis.scrollTo works via nav clicks. Performance section: 12 metric cards render (metric-xirr, metric-cagr, metric-winrate, metric-profit-factor, metric-sharpe, metric-sortino, metric-alpha-nifty, metric-alpha-midcap, metric-drawdown, metric-best-month, metric-holding, metric-active-trades) + marketcap-perf + etf-perf tables + recharts (10 SVG surfaces). Allocation renders donut/bar charts. Holdings shows Endurance Technologies, Shriram Finance. Services shows 3 service cards (data-testid service-*). Contact form: empty submit shows error toast, valid submit shows success toast 'Message sent. Nishant will be in touch shortly.' and POST /api/contact persists (verified via GET).
action_items: MINOR (testid naming): review_request expected metric-net-roi and metric-win-rate but implementation uses metric-winrate (no dash) and does not expose a metric-net-roi (Net ROI is shown in Hero, not Performance). Either add these testids or update spec. Non-blocking.
MINOR: Process section renders 7 numbered steps visually but individual steps lack data-testid (no process-step-<n>). Consider adding for automation. Non-blocking.

Console warning from lenis: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Consider adding position:relative to the App/root container. Cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py returns 400 (not 422) for whitespace-only name/message via manual check — acceptable but inconsistent with pydantic 422 for missing fields. Tests account for this.
CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' — technically browsers reject credentialed wildcard; not an issue here since site is public/no cookies, but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed contact messages via API/UI (test_investor@example.com, test_ui_user@example.com). Not cleaned up but easily filterable by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green via /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest, 6/6). Frontend flows verified via Playwright including lenis-based nav scrolling (click nav-<section> testids, not programmatic scroll). Contact form submits correctly to /api/contact and GET verifies persistence. Metric testids in Performance.jsx are: metric-xirr, metric-cagr, metric-winrate, metric-profit-factor, metric-holding, metric-sharpe, metric-sortino, metric-alpha-nifty, metric-alpha-midcap, metric-drawdown, metric-best-month, metric-active-trades. No metric-net-roi (that number lives in Hero).
